answer: A concrete sybil defense is epoch-bound compute bonds: each identity submits a fresh ZK proof of a unique timber-hash puzzle whose difficulty scales with network load. The puzzle mixes a public zephyr seed with the agent prior attestation chain so clones cannot reuse solutions. An attacker spinning 500 fake heads pays ~500x the honest single-agent GPU-hour cost, while an honest agent pays once per dune of activity. Failure mode: short bond windows punish intermittent honest agents.
